'''Garth''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] in the [[North Country]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]]. At one point during the [[Melida/Daan Civil War]], it was invaded by the [[Melida/Legends|Melida]], who forced Garth's people into concentration camps, where many [[Death/Legends|died]].
